title: Instructions for Form 8959 (2025), Additional Medicare Tax

passages.question: Do the Whitfords owe Additional Medicare Tax?
passages.excerpt: A 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax applies to your Medicare wages ... above a threshold amount ... Married filing jointly $250,000 ... Your employer is responsible for withholding the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on your Medicare wages ... paid in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year.
